Name: Bundles Preview
Author: strawberriaaa
Description:
[size=4][b][center]Sick and tired of being blindsided by modded bundles when Spring is already over?
Do you just not want to tab-out and consult the Stardew Valley wiki [i]all the time[/i]?[/center][/b][/size]
[u][i][center]"You're telling me NOW that I needed high-quality [insert spring crop here] for this bundle!?" - the author, Year 1 Spring 21[/center][/i][/u]

Now you can preview bundles beforehand from your inventory, before unlocking individual bundle areas and even the community center itself!
Just navigate to your inventory, click on the normal "Community Center" button, and everything shows up normally!

[size=4][b]Known Incompatibilities[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url]﻿ - will show "strange Junimo text" when clicking the bundle overview in the inventory instead of the bundles themselves, if the player hasn't yet learned how to read the Junimo language. [i][b]Not yet tested after learning the Junimo language, and probably unstable.[/b][/i]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Bugfix: would receive "rat problem" mail early if bundles were viewed from inventory

Manifest.Name: PreviewBundles
Manifest.Description: Enables bundles to be viewed from the inventory even if they haven't been unlocked'
